name: Restaurant Wildfang
kurzbeschreibung: **Restaurant Wildfang** in **Mittenwald** – a cozy alpine gem nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** countryside. Here, hearty Bavarian dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh trout from the **Inn**, and homemade dumplings take center stage. The rustic charm of the wooden interiors and the warm hospitality make every meal feel like a homecoming. Whether you're craving a hearty **Schweinsbraten** or a light **Käsespätzle**, this spot delivers pure mountain flavor. Don’t miss the local **Apfelstrudel** for dessert—best enjoyed with a cold **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner**. A must-visit for food lovers exploring the **Zugspitze** region!
